location: EIP-7928, Gas Validation Before State Access, against the execution specification

en.title: EIP-7928: the text does not say that a static-context halt comes before pre-state validation
en.summary: EIP-7928 says that once pre-state validation passes, the target is accessed and included in the block access list. It does not mention a static context. Take a call with value inside a static frame, with enough gas: pre-state validation passes, so by the text the target goes in the list. The execution specification halts such a call before any gas check, and its test requires the target to stay out of the list. The other state-accessing instructions that a static frame does not allow follow the same order.
en.impact: A call with value inside a static frame, with enough gas: by the EIP the target is in the block access list; by the execution specification and its test it is not. Three coding agents wrote the inclusion check from the current text and all three recorded the target. In three runs with an earlier draft of the proposed paragraph, none did.
en.correction: Add a paragraph after the pre-state validation rule: a state-accessing instruction that a static context does not allow halts before pre-state validation, no gas check applies, and the target stays out of the list unless it was accessed for another reason. Proposed in pull request 12611.
